title: Permutation Coloring Game
statement: Alice and Bob alternately paint 1 to k (k ≤ 20) white elements of a permutation of length up to 2·10^5 one color; Alice wins if same-color swaps sort it, i.e. every permutation cycle ends monochromatic. Alice may only paint whole cycles, so her first move is a knapsack over cycles of total size ≤ k that defuses Bob's one-element-per-cycle threat; a (k+1)-cycle adds a subtraction game mod k+1.
